import json, subprocess, sys

def run(obj):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"],
                       input=json.dumps(obj).encode(), capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode()

def show(name, obj):
    rc,out = run(obj)
    print("=== "+name, "rc=%d"%rc)
    print(out.strip())

# Test A: no rounds
show("A no-rounds", {"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],
  "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"}],"rounds":[]})
